scope: live Groq generation over local BGE retrieval on QASPER text; NOT the full Gemini-FAISS application

criteria.frozen_before: any live call of this experiment
criteria.questions: the 123 frozen QASPER test questions (retrieval-eligible; retrieval on this set was examined before; answer-level results for 88 of them are new, 35 were generated in the earlier pilot with configuration A)

configs.A: structure-aware T=256, dense BGE top-4 (reuses 35 exactly-matching pilot answers)
configs.REF: A + MiniLM cross-encoder rerank of the dense top-20 (selected on dev)
configs.D: REF with an LLM-rewritten search query; evaluated only if it advances on the 41 dev questions

fixed.rewriter: openai/gpt-oss-20b, sees only the question (never references or evidence), max_completion_tokens 256

criteria.D_dev_rule: D advances only if dev evidence recall at 1,024 tokens improves >= 0.02 over REF, or MRR@10 >= 0.03 with recall not lower by more than 0.02
criteria.primary_endpoint: official QASPER answer F1, REF minus A, paired paper-clustered bootstrap (10,000 reps, seed 7)
criteria.decision: 'improved' if 95% CI lower bound > 0; 'non-inferior' if lower bound > -0.05; 'degraded' if upper bound < -0.05; otherwise 'inconclusive'

status.reason: stopped safely on Groq free-tier tokens-per-day limit for openai/gpt-oss-120b (200,000 TPD; 199,711 used incl. the earlier pilot); 1 request refused (429), not retried
status.interim_caveat: missing questions are the last ones in run order (not a random subset); the frozen 123-question endpoint is not yet evaluated
status.drift_note: 35 A answers reused from the pilot (identical contexts, prompt hash, model id and settings); provider model weights may change silently between runs; new-responses-only sensitivity reported
